title: Search state update
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $D_j$ be a directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n+j$ inputs for each natural number $j$. Given a natural number $j$ and a state consisting of a list of gates and a list of vertex indices, append to the gate list the embedded gates of $D_{j+1}$, using as sources the indices $0,\ldots,n-1$, the existing vertex indices, and then $n$, with the embedding offset $n$ plus the current gate-list length. Append to the index list the vertex index $n$ plus the current gate-list length plus the number of gates of $D_{j+1}$.
